title: Vedal's Chicken Bake
description: A texture pack that turns the cooked chicken texture into a chicken bake.
body:
This resource packs changes the cooked chicken texture to a greggs chicken bake, that literally all it does.

![greggs chicken bake](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2262c8014abfdab8f58ddf9b07ec5ed7cc3962df.jpeg)
